topics.name: INFLUENCES ON, AND CONTROL FACTORS RELATING TO THE BUSINESS ENVIRONMENTS
subtopics: Ways to be involved in business environments if beneficial to business: (Recap components of business environments)
Micro environment
The business vision, mission statement, goals and objectives, organisational resources, management and leadership, eight functions and activities of the business
Market environment

The consumers/customers, suppliers intermediaries, competitors, other organisations/civil society (e.g., community-based organisations – CBOs, non-governmental organisations – NGOs, regulators, strategic allies and unions)
Macro environment

The physical/natural environment/economic environment/social, cultural, and demographic environment/technological environment/legal and political environment/international/global environment/institutional environment
Examination of control factors, e.g. more control over micro environment, less control over market environment and no control over macro environment
topics.prior_knowledge: Grade 10 knowledge of the three business environments and their components

topics.name: ADAPTING TO CHALLENGES OF BUSINESS ENVIRONMENTS

Lobbying, e.g. hedging against inflation bargaining sessions between management and unions, influencing supervisory body/regulators, etc.
Networking, e.g. finding new customers etc.
Power relationships e.g. strategic alliance agreements, persuasion of large investors company representatives’ influence, etc.
topics.prior_knowledge: How each component/feature of the macro business environment poses challenges to businesses.
